svg.title: THE ASHEN FOUNDRY
svg.desc: Top-down schematic of the 19x19 forge hall in the Cinder Steps: fire shell, lava channels, vault and spawners. A navigation diagram, not an in-game screenshot.
svg.text: 19 x 19 forge hall, top down. Entrance at the south gap.
Quench once with two seals attuned:
the vault opens. The quench holds.
